from pathlib import Path
import collections, gzip, hashlib, json, statistics

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(name):
    b = (P / name).read_bytes()
    return json.loads(gzip.decompress(b) if name.endswith('.gz') else b)
def stable(value): return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'))
def bootstrap(values):
    state = 17112026
    def next_int():
        nonlocal state
        state ^= (state << 13) & 0xffffffff; state ^= state >> 17; state ^= (state << 5) & 0xffffffff; state &= 0xffffffff
        return state
    means = sorted(sum(values[next_int() % len(values)] for _ in values) / len(values) * 100 for _ in range(20000))
    return [means[500], means[19500]]

reg = read('registration.json'); reg_hash = hashlib.sha256((P / 'registration.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
families = []; counters = collections.Counter(); sources = {}; timings = collections.defaultdict(list)
for task in read('cases.json'):
    deltas = []; changes = 0; danger = 0; scores = collections.defaultdict(float)
    for seat in [0, 1]:
        for future in [0, 1]:
            case = f'{task["id"]}-s{seat}-f{future}'
            paths = {m:f'pilot/{case}-{m}.json.gz' for m in ['observe', 'candidate']}
            rows = {m:read(path) for m,path in paths.items()}
            assert read(f'pilot/complete-{case}.json')['qualityPassed']
            for mode,row in rows.items():
                assert row['qualityPassed'] and row['receipt']['qualityPassed']
                assert row['registrationSha256'] == reg_hash
                assert row['score'] in [0, 0.5, 1]
                assert row['result']['winner'] in ['green', 'red', 'draw']
                expected = 0.5 if row['result']['winner'] == 'draw' else int(row['result']['winner'] == ('green' if row['candidateTeam'] == 2 else 'red'))
                assert row['score'] == expected
                counters[f'{mode}_battles'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_wins' if row['score']==1 else f'{mode}_draws' if row['score']==0.5 else f'{mode}_losses'] += 1
                counters[f'{mode}_roots'] += len(row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_danger_roots'] += sum(o['danger'] for o in row['observations'])
                counters[f'{mode}_overrides'] += sum(o['changed'] for o in row['observations'])
                timings[mode].append(row['elapsedMs'])
                sources[paths[mode]] = hashlib.sha256((P / paths[mode]).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
                scores[mode] += row['score']
            assert stable(rows['observe']['opening']) == stable(rows['candidate']['opening'])
            diff = rows['candidate']['score'] - rows['observe']['score']; deltas.append(diff)
            counters['better_cases' if diff > 0 else 'worse_cases' if diff < 0 else 'tied_cases'] += 1
            changed = stable(rows['candidate']['turns']) != stable(rows['observe']['turns'])
            changes += changed
            if changed: counters['changed_trajectories'] += 1
            else:
                for field in ['result','events','health']: assert stable(rows['candidate'][field]) == stable(rows['observe'][field])
            danger += sum(o['danger'] for o in rows['observe']['observations'])
    families.append({'id':task['id'],'map':task['map'],'d1':task['d1'],'d2':task['d2'],'pickOrder':task['pickOrder'],'delta':statistics.mean(deltas),'caseDeltas':deltas,'changedCases':changes,'baselineDangerRoots':danger,'scores':dict(scores)})
assert len(families) == 54 and counters['observe_battles'] == counters['candidate_battles'] == 216
values=[f['delta'] for f in families]; mean=statistics.mean(values)*100; interval=bootstrap(values)
groups={}
for axis in ['map','d1','d2','pickOrder']:
    groups[axis]={str(k):{'families':len([f for f in families if f[axis]==k]),'meanPp':statistics.mean(f['delta'] for f in families if f[axis]==k)*100} for k in sorted({f[axis] for f in families})}
changed_families=sum(f['changedCases'] > 0 for f in families)
gates={'meanAtLeastHalfPoint':mean>=0.5,'lower95StrictlyPositive':interval[0]>0,'atLeastSixChangedFamilies':changed_families>=6,'noMapOrDoctrineBelowMinusTwoPoints':all(g['meanPp']>=-2 for axis in ['map','d1','d2'] for g in groups[axis].values())}
summary={'registrationSha256':reg_hash,'complete':True,'battles':432,'families':54,'meanScoreGainPp':mean,'familyBootstrap95Pp':interval,'counters':dict(counters),'changedFamilies':changed_families,'subgroups':groups,'gates':gates,'screenPassed':all(gates.values()),'promotionAuthorized':False,'wallTimeIsSharedLoadDescriptiveOnly':True,'medianBattleMs':{k:statistics.median(v) for k,v in timings.items()},'familyResults':families}
with(P/'analysis.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
with(P/'result-receipts.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(sources,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in summary.items() if k not in ['familyResults','subgroups']}))

from pathlib import Path
import collections, gzip, json, statistics

P = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
def read(name):
    b=(P/name).read_bytes();return json.loads(gzip.decompress(b) if name.endswith('.gz') else b)
def same(a,b):return json.dumps(a,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))==json.dumps(b,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
rows=[];counts=collections.Counter();family=collections.defaultdict(list)
for job in read('branches.json'):
    b=read(f'pilot/{job["id"]}-observe.json.gz');a=read(f'branches/{job["id"]}.json.gz')
    assert a['qualityPassed'] and a['receipt']['qualityPassed'] and a['intervention']['matchedRootExactly']
    assert same(a['opening'],b['opening'])
    first=next((i for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a['turns'],b['turns'])) if not same(x,y)),None)
    assert first is not None
    native=b['turns'][first];changed=a['turns'][first]
    assert native['unitId']==changed['unitId']==job['root']['actor']['id']
    assert same(native['chosenDecision'],job['root']['chosen'])
    assert same(changed['chosenDecision'],job['alternative']['actions'])
    assert same(a['turns'][:first],b['turns'][:first])
    diff=a['score']-b['score'];family[job['task']['id']].append(diff)
    counts['better' if diff>0 else 'worse' if diff<0 else 'tied']+=1
    row={'case':job['id'],'family':job['task']['id'],'actor':job['root']['actor']['name'],'lap':job['root']['lap'],
         'baselineScore':b['score'],'branchScore':a['score'],'delta':diff,'prefixTurnsIdentical':first,
         'baselineForecast':next(s for s,c in zip(job['root']['scores'][-1]['means'],job['root']['scores'][-1]['candidates']) if same(c['actions'],job['root']['chosen'])),
         'alternativeForecast':job['alternative']['mean']}
    rows.append(row)
summary={'kind':'Reused-bank one-shot causal diagnostic, not a fresh policy strength estimate',
         'complete':True,'cases':len(rows),'affectedFamilies':len(family),'counts':dict(counts),
         'pairedScoreChangePp':statistics.mean(r['delta'] for r in rows)*100 if rows else 0,
         'familyMeanScoreChangePp':statistics.mean(statistics.mean(v) for v in family.values())*100 if family else 0,
         'allPrefixesExact':True,'casesDetailed':rows,'noServingChange':True}
with(P/'branch-analysis.json').open('x')as f:json.dump(summary,f,indent=2);f.write('\n')
print(json.dumps(summary))
